description: 昆仑洞天多模型语义转译基座V2，解决中文审美术语在不同AI模型中的歧义问题

global_rules.character: single person, exactly one head on shoulders
global_rules.hair: pure black long straight hair to waist
global_rules.style: ancient Chinese mythology, no western elements
global_rules.tone: majestic and serene, no horror or decay

agnes_image.prompt_prefix: A single elegant Chinese female deity, exactly one person, exactly one single head on shoulders, only one face, no other people, no clones, tall slender graceful figure with perfect proportions, body height equals 9 times the length of her own head, pure black long straight hair flowing to waist, wearing flowing cold white and crimson gold silk robes,
agnes_image.prompt_suffix: soft silver moonlight rim light from behind, UE5 ray tracing, cinematic photography, 9:16 vertical composition, ancient Chinese mythology aesthetic, no western elements, no angel wings, no masculine features

known_pitfalls.九头身: Never use nine-head body. Use: body height equals 9 times the length of her own head
known_pitfalls.玄黑: Never use mysterious black. Use: deep dark crimson-black
known_pitfalls.赤金: Never use red gold. Use: crimson gold with warm undertone
known_pitfalls.神女: Never use Greek goddess. Use: elegant Chinese female deity

tongyi_i2v.prompt_prefix: single Chinese goddess, cinematic, slow motion,

known_pitfalls.动作描述: Use gentle motion descriptions, not fast action
known_pitfalls.镜头: Use slow camera movement, no shake

zhipu_text.prompt_style: Chinese natural language, direct use of Chinese aesthetic terms

九头身.for_agnes_image: body height equals 9 times the length of her own head

赤金.for_agnes_image: crimson gold, warm golden with red undertone

昆仑.for_agnes_image: ancient Chinese mythical palace on mountain

rules_v2: R1: All image prompts must include exactly one person, exactly one single head
R2: Proportion terms must use numerical description, not metaphor
R3: Each model has its own prompt template, cannot be shared
R4: After generation, must validate: one head only
R5: Ambiguous terms must look up semantic mapping table
R6: All keyframes/videos must be strictly 9:16 vertical
R7: Agnes does not support negative_prompt, all constraints in positive prompt
R8: Tongyi video is async, must poll task status
R9: Generated media must be downloaded to local server, not external URL
R10: All output must have trace symbol Ω₀⊂⊙∞⊂Ω
